_comment: Candidate study areas, format: west,south,east,north in WGS84 degrees.
These are starting estimates centred on plausible neighbourhoods. Before
running the survey, open https://www.mapillary.com/app and pan over each
one to sanity-check that the box covers what you think it covers, then
adjust. Each box below is roughly 1.5 x 1.5 km (about 2.3 km^2), which is
4 API tiles at the 0.009-degree tile size.
Selection logic: campus_core has the densest pedestrian traffic and the
highest chance of existing Mapillary coverage. wl_residential_north is the
one most likely to reveal real barriers, because postwar residential
streets are where curb ramps were never retrofitted. Survey both.
